headline: Autotune W33/W34 recommended ZERO knob changes (every sweep below the 5-trade evidence bar; .env verified unchanged), while the nightly postmortems' two biggest 'stop failure' lessons (AMZN -$14,956, HL -$3,650) are misattributed — both were watchdog OPTION-premium stops ledgered under the underlying ticker, and the real recurring leaks are uncorroborated single-soft-signal entries and unenforced single-name daily-buy concentration.
evidence: (1) KNOB RECS: Autotune 2026-W33 (14d window, 20 round trips) and 2026-W34 (25 round trips) each swept 5 knobs — MIN_NEW_NAME_CONVICTION (cur 0.6), MIN_CONVICTION (cur 0.2), REENTRY_PRICE_OVERRIDE_COMPOSITE (cur 1.25), ROTATION_GUARD_MAX_LOSS_PCT (cur 8), ROTATION_GUARD_REPEAT_RELEASE_PCT (cur 0.75) — and made ZERO recommendations: every candidate row showed 0 affected trades except one. Applied: nothing; .env values verified identical to autotune 'current' column on 2026-08-23.

(1 cont) The single non-zero sweep cell: W34 REENTRY_PRICE_OVERRIDE_COMPOSITE candidate 1.5 → 1 trade affected, $2,085 losses avoided, $0 winners missed (this is INTC -$2,085 on Aug 18, re-bought above its $97.88 exit after being correctly rejected Aug 14). Below the 5-trade bar, so autotune withheld the recommendation — but it is the only evidence-backed tightening on the table.

(2) THEME concentration: single name eats the day's buy dollars — SMCI 100% of ~$82k ceiling Aug 12; NVDA+CDE ~35% each Aug 17; SMCI $39k largest Aug 20; PCG 77% ($30k of $39k) Aug 21. 6 of 15 curated lessons (lines 1,3,4,6,15) repeat 'flag >50-70% concentration' — flagged nightly, never enforced by any gate.

(2) THEME uncorroborated soft-signal entries fail fast: insider-buy-only QNT -$1,621 + LFTO -$1,634 closed within ~1-2h same day (Aug 13, identical thesis template 'insider +1.00, w=0.91'), INTC -$2,085 insider-anchor (Aug 18), options-flow starters F -$842/ONDS (Aug 18), AVBC -$493 insider scanner (Aug 21) ≈ -$6.7k total; meanwhile corroborated multi-signal names won: SMCI +$9,437, AXTI +$7,632, CDE +$7,615 and +$8,245, IESC +$1,194. Curated lines 7, 12, 13 all restate this.

(2) THEME hold asymmetry flagged in all 8 nightlies: losers held ~1.9-3.2d vs winners ~4.9-6.4d. Interpretation drifts night to night, but Aug 17/21 converge on the correct read: exit discipline is healthy; entry timing is the leak. (2) THEME capacity: max-15 position cap turned away 0.60-0.62 conviction ideas on Aug 12 (NOK), Aug 13 (HLIT), Aug 21 (PFE 0.61, BULL 0.60).

(3) CONTRADICTION lessons-vs-autotune: nightlies keep prescribing 'tighten entry quality / require corroboration', but autotune's conviction-floor sweeps show 0 trades affected at EVERY candidate (0.35-0.6 new-name, 0.1-0.3 global) — all the losing entries cleared the floors comfortably (QNT/LFTO conviction implied >0.6, HL 0.63). Conviction floors cannot express the fix; it needs a new corroboration/multi-signal gate, not knob tightening.

(3) CONTRADICTION lessons-vs-lessons: curated line 8 ('don't dump fresh entries within hours on a soft decision exit') directly conflicts with line 9 and the Aug 20/21 diagnostics ('cutting losers fast is working/healthy'). Aug 19's 'cut-winners-short / hold-losers pattern' states the asymmetry backwards (losers 3.2d < winners 6.3d = winners held longer) and contradicts Aug 21's reading of the same numbers.

(5) WRONG LESSON — Aug 17 AMZN: postmortem calls -50.2% 'catastrophic for a clean corroborated long... gapping through the stop or sizing/leverage far beyond thesis' on a large-cap. Ledger (state/trades.jsonl 2026-08-17T16:57Z) shows it was a watchdog OPTION stop on the 26-contract 5-leg AMZN Sep-2026 call group (the same group from the PR #52 MLEG-cap fix), exiting at -50.19% of premium — i.e. OPTION_STOP_LOSS_PCT=50 firing exactly as configured. Not a stop-width or equity-sizing failure; the real issue is ~$29.8k premium in one name's options.

(5) WRONG LESSON — Aug 20 HL: postmortem says 'stop was too wide for the position'. Ledger shows a defined-risk 50-contract bull_call_spread ($5,200 debit, bought Aug 19 17:03Z) closed by watchdog option stop at -67.6% of premium — stop width doesn't apply to a capped-debit spread. The buried real lesson: HL EQUITY was blocked by the overextension gate (RSI 70, 4.2xATR) that same cycle and the bot expressed the identical overextended thesis via options — options are an unguarded bypass of the overextension gate. Also note -67.6% overshot the 50% watchdog threshold (gap/slippage between ticks).

(5) WRONG-ISH LESSON — curated line 14 ('tighten stop width so single lots cannot lose >30-40%') inherits the AMZN/HL options misattribution; applied to equities it would fight DEFAULT_STOP_LOSS_PCT=8.0 which backtests chose deliberately. Curated line 11 ('require fresh non-extended confirmation before late-session buy of an overextension-rejected name') was motivated by CDE Aug 17 — but CDE became the window's best performer (+$15,860 across Aug 20-21 trail/top-up), so its lone supporting example is a counterexample in hindsight.

(4) Realized P&L reconstructable from the 8 nightlies (Aug 12-21): ~+$11.6k net (winners ~$43.8k: SMCI 9437, CDE 8245+7615, AXTI 7632, PLTR 4466, PATH 3925, IBIT 1259, IESC 1194; losers ~$32.2k dominated by AMZN -14956 and HL -3650 options stops) — consistent with the observation-window verdict that expectancy is fine but single-name/single-position reversals drive the red days (down-capture 2.22).

Files read: /Users/spusapati/Personal/Investment_stratergy/state/autotune/2026-W33.md, 2026-W34.md; state/lessons/2026-08-12.md through 2026-08-21.md (8 files; Aug 15/16 weekend, none exist); state/lessons/curated.md; knob verification in .env; option-trade verification in state/trades.jsonl.
surprises: Autotune is structurally blind to the two biggest documented losses: AMZN -$14,956 and HL -$3,650 were options trades, and none of the 5 swept knobs touch options (no sweep exists for OPTION_STOP_LOSS_PCT, options sizing, or an options-side overextension gate) — the self-evaluation loop cannot see its own largest loss channel.

HL options entry explicitly routed around the equity overextension gate ('Equity blocked as overextended... expressing via capped-debit bull_call_spread' in its own rationale) and lost 67.6% next morning — the bot documented its own gate bypass and the nightly postmortem still misdiagnosed it as a stop-width problem.
The HL watchdog option stop executed at -67.6%, well past the configured -50% premium threshold — watchdog tick granularity or an opening gap produces ~17pp of slippage beyond the supposed floor.

Conviction floors discriminated nothing: every loser in the window entered with conviction comfortably above 0.6 — the entire 'entry quality' problem lives in signal composition (single-source vs corroborated), a dimension no current knob encodes.
Curated.md contains internally contradictory guidance (line 8 vs line 9) and at least two hindsight-wrong entries (lines 11, 14) — a planner consuming curated.md raw would import the misattributions.

The only quantified autotune finding in two weeks (REENTRY override 1.25→1.5, +$2,085, n=1) aligns perfectly with an independent nightly lesson (INTC re-entry), yet is suppressed by the 5-trade threshold — cross-referencing the two self-eval streams recovers signal each stream alone discards.
